title: Support local Clef models and rename to systemone-model-api
description: Add Cloudflare Clef and Clef-flash inference alongside the existing local Laya backend. Rename distribution, package, CLI, deployment and configuration references to systemone-model-api without compatibility shims.
acceptance_criteria: Existing Laya /predict behavior remains available. Clef and Clef-flash run using Cloudflare's published inference contract. Package installs with the renamed command and imports. API schema and deployment documentation match the implementation. Exercise actual inference code and endpoint validation; explicitly record hardware limits on full-size models.
design: Keep local inference and /predict. Select one model per worker using SYSTEMONE_MODEL (laya default, clef, clef-flash). Rename API-key env to SYSTEMONE_API_KEY and package to systemone_model_api. Load backends at application startup so OpenAPI generation does not load weights. Clef uses pinned official Hugging Face runtime and matching weights. No hosted Cloudflare proxy or multi-model residency.
notes: Implementation complete: renamed distribution/module/CLI/config/Docker; local Clef and flash adapters with pinned releases; lifespan model loading; bounded embedded images. uv sync succeeds. Live Laya HTTP smoke passed all question types, arrays, auth 401, model mismatch 422, invalid media/boolean schema 422. Official Clef AutoProcessor loads after adding torchvision. Full checkpoints exceed available GPU memory; preparing real tiny Qwen3.5 release checkpoint to exercise official loader/systemone and multimodal API. OpenAPI regeneration/docs/cleanup pending after smoke.
close_reason: Implemented local Clef and Clef-flash with pinned official code/weights, one backend per worker, bounded embedded images and existing /predict behavior. Renamed distribution, module, CLI, API-key environment variable, Docker and OpenAPI references to systemone-model-api. Updated README and lockfile. Verification: real Laya HTTP inference for all question types; actual upstream Clef loader/systemone with a real tiny Qwen3.5 checkpoint for both model selectors and text/image paths; auth/input/startup failures exercised; six media safety tests pass; uv build produced renamed sdist/wheel and correct console entry point. Full-size Clef weights were not tested because they exceed available GPU memory; this is documented. Smoke services stopped and temporary artifacts removed.
